[[Ivar]] and his band of rebels, now known as the Uncrowned, attack the Castle of Raventree Hall. They lay waste to the fortress and rob it of its food stores and weapons to support their summer campaign. The Lord Decold was killed defending his castle. Ivar leaves a single squire alive and sends him on horseback to Terraven with a warning for Adrithyr, "What you did to my mother reveled your true self to me, and I shall show you to the world. You are no man, you are a beast. I will put you down like the dog you are."
